source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel ?born WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(STR(?bornT), "|", STR(?bornP)); separator=";") AS ?born) WHERE { ?item wdt:P106 wd:Q17125263 ; wdt:P31 wd:Q5 ; wdt:P27 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . ?item p:P2397 ?ch . ?ch pq:P3744 ?subs . FILTER(?subs > 3000000) FILTER(?sitelinks > 8) ?item p:P569 ?bornSt . ?bornSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P569 [ wikibase:timeValue ?bornT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?bornP ] . } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) = 1) ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 250 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
